hypothesis_reference: Phase 3b — fix for STR_1676 regime feature collinearity (regime probs same per date, no ranking power). Solution: interaction terms z_fi * prob_k are stock-specific.
academic_basis: Gu, Kelly & Xiu (2020, RFS) — XGBoost for asset pricing
Kan & Zhang (1999, JF) — useless factors in cross-sectional regressions

key_modification.description: After MI prefilter selects top-50 factors, top-5 MI factors are identified. Interaction features z_fi * prob_k (5 factors x 5 regime probs = 25 terms) are appended to feature matrix. Total features: 75.
key_modification.why_interactions: Regime probs are market-wide (same for all stocks at date d). Direct inclusion does not change cross-sectional ranking. Interaction terms are STOCK-SPECIFIC because factor z-scores differ per stock.
key_modification.example: In liquidity stress (high prob_2), stock A with high z_quality gets high z_quality*prob_2; stock B with low z_quality gets low z_quality*prob_2 — XGBoost can learn to upweight quality in stress regimes.

features.interaction_construction: top-5 MI factors (highest IC in IS window) x 5 regime probs (prob_1 ~ prob_5)

regime_data.pit_note: Regime date d covers IS period [IS_START, is_end_d]. Rolling join (data.table roll=TRUE) maps daily dates to most-recent prior regime month.

pit_checks.C1: Expanding window IS only. No full-sample statistics.
pit_checks.C2: 21d purge gap between IS end and OOS start. Quarter-end scores used next day.
pit_checks.C13: zscore_by_date applied to factor columns. Z_Score_Aligned enforced.
pit_checks.C14: fwd_ret_21d IS target computed from t+1 to t+21 returns. Month-end only. Regime probs from past expanding PCA/Kmeans at t-1 months.
pit_checks.C9: Regime probs from t-1 month-end. Rolling join ensures no future regime data leaks.
pit_checks.interaction_pit: z_score(stock d) x prob(market, from regime at t-1 months). Both components observable at decision date d.

STR_1676_MetaRegime.note: regime features same per date, no ranking power

opt_compliance.regime_load: read_parquet once at startup (small file ~200 rows)
